gcode_macro PRINT_START.gcode:
{% set target_bed = params.BED|default(110)|int %}
{% set target_extruder = params.EXTRUDER|default(260)|int %}
{% set target_chamber = params.CHAMBER|default(40)|int %}
{% set brush_z = params.BRUSH_Z|default(printer["gcode_macro CLEAN_NOZZLE"].brush_z)|float %}
{% set brush_wipes = params.BRUSH_WIPES|default(printer["gcode_macro CLEAN_NOZZLE"].wipe_count)|int %}
{% set require_filament = params.REQUIRE_FILAMENT|default(0)|int %}


M118 >>> [JOB_START] Initializing Klipper Deployment Pipeline...
SET_GCODE_OFFSET Z=0
{% if require_filament %}
ASSERT_TOOLHEAD_FILAMENT
{% else %}
FILAMENT_STATUS
M118 >>> [WARN] Filament sensors are monitor-only. Use REQUIRE_FILAMENT=1 after PB5/PB6 verification.
{% endif %}




M118 >>> [STAGE: PRE-HEAT] Target Bed: {target_bed}C, Standby Extruder: 140C
M117 Pre-heating...
M104 S140
M140 S{target_bed}

G28
G90
G0 X120 Y125 Z30 F6000

M190 S{target_bed}
M118 >>> [STATUS] Bed temperature reached. Thermal expansion stabilized.




M118 >>> [STAGE: NOZZLE_CLEAN] Cleaning nozzle on rear brush...
M109 S140
CLEAN_NOZZLE Z={brush_z} WIPES={brush_wipes}




M118 >>> [STAGE: VALIDATION] Checking Gantry & Surface Mesh...
CQGL

CLEAN_NOZZLE Z={brush_z} WIPES={brush_wipes}
G28 Z

G90
G0 X120 Y125 Z10 F6000

M117 Meshing with Eddy...
BED_MESH_CALIBRATE METHOD=scan ADAPTIVE=1

M118 >>> [STATUS] Validation complete. Kinematics verified.




M118 >>> [STAGE: WIDTH] Enabling BDWidth filament diameter monitoring.
SET_BDWIDTH NAME=fila_width_0 COMMAND=ENABLE




M118 >>> [STAGE: PURGE] Moving to Purge Area...
G0 X15 Y20 Z10 F6000

M117 Confirming Extruder Temperature...
M109 S{target_extruder}

M118 >>> [STATUS] Execution: Purge Line starting...
M117 Purging...


G92 E0
G0 Z0.3 F3000
G1 Y150 E15 F1500
G1 X15.4 F6000
G1 Y20 E30 F1500

G92 E0
G0 Z2.0 F3000


M118 >>> [SUCCESS] Deployment successful. Start Printing...
M117 Printing...

gcode_macro _START_PRINT.description: START_PRINT 스마트 히팅 및 검증 파이프라인 Alias

gcode_macro PRINT_END.gcode:
{% set th = printer.toolhead %}
{% set x_safe = th.axis_maximum.x - 20 %}
{% set y_safe = th.axis_maximum.y - 20 %}
{% set z_safe = [th.position.z + 2, th.axis_maximum.z]|min %}

M400
G92 E0
G1 E-1.0 F3600
M104 S100

TURN_OFF_HEATERS
SET_BDWIDTH NAME=fila_width_0 COMMAND=DISABLE

G90
G0 Z{z_safe} F3600
G0 X{x_safe} Y{y_safe} F3600
M107

BED_MESH_CLEAR
